title: Leap Academy (Ilana Golan) — 'The Lean Startup: Eric Ries Reveals the #1 Mistake New Founders Make'
summary: Ilana Golan — Leap Academy founder, executive coach — runs a launch-week 1h 19m episode (E160) tracing Eric's path from his first startup's collapse through the Lean Startup methodology to the controversial idea behind Incorruptible.
blockquote: In this episode, Eric chats with Ilana about why most startups fail before they even launch, how to test ideas early to uncover what actually works, and how leaders can build companies that scale without losing their values.
attribution_title: Podcast hosted by Ilana Golan — Leap Academy founder, executive coach
